No shutter-count readout (software screen or menu display) shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have functional faults (dead sensor, shutter failure, dial issues)
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, mode dial turning, shutter firing, and LCD displaying live view

risks.risk: Actual shutter count could be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of shutter count from EOS Info tool, camera menu, or third-party shutter-count software

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches hidden by the cap
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements with cap off, lens held up to light
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with optical defects

risks.risk: LCD screen could be cracked, dead-pixeled, or dim
risks.proof: Photo of screen open and powered on, displaying an image or menu

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not actually be included or may be third-party/degraded
risks.proof: Photo of battery and charger laid out next to the camera, with battery health shown if possible
risks.if_unproven: priced as body/lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust, scratches, or stuck pixels affecting image quality
risks.proof: Sample test shot against a plain white/blue sky background at small aperture

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage on unseen surfaces (bottom plate, battery door, mount screws) indicating drops or prior repair
risks.proof: Photos of camera underside, battery compartment interior, and lens mount screws
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, possible prior damage

proof_requests: Power-on video showing shutter firing and live LCD view
Shutter count screenshot from camera menu or EOS Info software
Close-up of lens front/rear elements with cap removed, under light
Photo of battery, charger, and any included accessories together with the camera
Sample test photograph to check sensor/image quality
Photos of camera underside, battery door, and lens mount area
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Canon EOS 650D DSLR with 18-55mm kit lens, so a worst-case price is possible, but functional state, shutter count, lens glass condition, and included accessories remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proof is supplied.
